main_body: multi-story brick townhouse with mansard slate roof
top_band: grey/blue-grey roof crown and sloped slate roof from row 16 to 43 (plus orange eave cornice 44-45)
evidence: Rows 16-43 show the top roof deck and forward-sloping slate roof above an orange cornice (rows 44-45), eave shadow (row 46), and vertical brick facade (rows 47-142) with recessed door and windows.

style.evidence: Bricks and slates use blocky 3-4 step shading with heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormer, and chimney, lacking the fine per-tile/stone speckle and tinted material outlines of the Beodeul references.
